files: scripts/jev_annotate.py -- project_artifact(): the artifact keys it reads, and the settings/generation keys it keeps
tests/test_loop_demo.py -- make_artifact() and test_the_fixture_batch_is_in_the_studio_run_job_output_shape(): the run-job output shape the loop walks
scripts/slop_cannon.py -- measure_raster(): the slop_* measurement key names
transcribed_from.rule: a ONE-WAY pin, transcribed by READING the jev source. The studio never imports the jev repo at runtime; its cross-repo pins are fixtures, exactly as test/fixtures/meme_vocabulary.json is.

required.prompt: a non-empty string at the TOP level of the artifact; project_artifact() raises ValueError without one

not_carried.phrase_root: read by the projector when present, but optional and absent from the loop demo's batch shape
not_carried.sampler: no studio lever or panel field writes it; the projector keeps an absent key absent rather than null
not_carried.topic: optional in the artifact; no Run Job panel writes it
not_carried.measurements: produced by the shipped measurement code over the raster AFTER the run, not by the contract
not_carried.generation: the run's own record (model, job id, raster filename), written when the run lands
not_carried.caption: carried only when a captioner supplied one; absent means prompt_adherence stays unevidenced
